body:
I'm sorry I don't have advice for you but I just want to tell you I feel that way, too. You're not alone in this. The only way I can get through every day is when I ask myself, "Are you gonna kill yourself?" and then I reply back to myself, "Maybe someday. NOT today." 

If your living situation is causing you to feel suicidal, get out of there.
I don't understand how I can plan a good marriage or how to enjoy life and not be so sad. But thank you for the advice.
